Identify compounds with exact IC50 measurements against both CHEMBL301 and CHEMBL4036. Filter for CHEMBL301 activities where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is less than 50 nM. Filter for CHEMBL4036 activities where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is greater than 200 nM. Intersect the compound sets to find those satisfying both conditions. Join the qualifying compounds to compound_structures. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
